title: The Semiotics of the Press Photo of The Israeli War on Gaza -October 2023- In the German Press: “Der Spiegel” Magazine Cover as a Model
core_idea: Use Roland Barthes' semiological framework to analyze linguistic, denotative, and connotative meanings of press images related to the October 2023 Israeli war on Gaza as reflected in six covers of Der Spiegel (issues from 14/10/2023 to 20/04/2024), employing a survey methodology for image analysis.
tldr: A Barthesian semiological survey of six Der Spiegel covers to interpret how German press imagery encodes and communicates the October 2023 Israeli–Gaza war through linguistic, denotative, and connotative levels.
